(Internal comp notes) — quick response while I’m offline-traveling. Per the SR-ML band v3 we currently target base 150–165k for band midpoint/top. The candidate's requested 175k exceeds our posted band. Options:

- Approve a band exception for up to a 5% uplift on base (to 173k) + a one-time sign-on up to $20k (requires exec approval).
- Keep base at 165k but offer $25k sign-on (if HR approves as signing allowance) — this has different compensation plan implications (sign-on charged to hiring budget vs base impacts ongoing comp).
- Alternatively, offer a performance-linked accelerated RSU vesting schedule for year one (front-loaded) in lieu of cash if candidate prefers equity.

I can prepare the short band-exception package to Laura for approval if Marcus wants to proceed. Need final ask by EOD Mon 8/16 to meet the candidate's Tuesday deadline.
